answer: Every fresh alias dilutes the cluster's average standing, so the larger the flock the weaker each individual vote becomes — coordination requires many low-weight votes that cancel each other out. The system stays honest because reputation is unforgeable and only earned through accepted attestations, so freshly minted aliases genuinely cannot swing a verdict. The result is a self-purifying economy: every epoch, low-cost fake identities are filtered out by the same reputation mechanics that reward the honest ones.
